tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
E.M.D shall be paid at the time of uploading of Tender itself. Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under single point vender registration are exempted from Paying EMD
The Prices quoted are to be kept valid for 120 Days from the date of opening of price bid for placement of order
Prices are FIRM. The rate shall be quoted separately slot provided on KPPP inclusive of GST as per price schedule (BOQ) and are negotiable
Payment term- As per section 4 SCC

Approximate Quantity Requirement as indicated in Section V: Schedule of Requirements. Full Quantity shall be offered by the Bidder. However, Purchase Order/ Release Order will be issued as and when required

Delivery Schedule. As per the KAVIKA requirement, Release Orders will be issued from time to time indicating the Delivery Schedule of the materials. Delivery Schedule indicating in the Release Order will be considered for levying the penalty towards delayed supplies. The Company is at liberty to alter the delivery dates on the lesser side to suit its needs as and when necessity arises, during the pendency of the contract
Penalty for delay in supplies i.e. 0.5% Per week initially for four weeks thereafter at the rate of 2% per week subject to Maximum of 10% of the basic price of the materials

The bidders must invariably upload only the required documents in the specific slots. The documents uploaded elsewhere in different slots wouldnot be taken into consideration, as provided in the eprocurement portal
All other terms and conditions as per tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should not be in Blacklist or Defaulter in any department of the Government of INDIA/Karnataka/ESCOMS /PSU and any other Government Departments.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience: The Tenderer should be a manufacturer/Dealer and shall have supplied minimum 20% of the tendered quantity indicated in Section-V (Schedule of Requirement) in any one year during the last 5 (Five) years to any Power Utility of State OR Central Government Transformer Manufacturers OR any Public and Private Sector Units

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall upload the Purchase order in support of their claim on experience in manufacturing/ supplying the tendered item

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Performance Certificate: Performance certificate issued from any Power Utility of State OR Central Government Transformer Manufacturers OR any Public or Private Sector Units.
GST Registration Certificate. Registration No. to be furnished and Copy of certificate to be Uploaded
Registration copy issued by CENTRAL/STATE Government shall be uploaded, if applicable

The Bidder shall ensure in self-declaration certificate that the material used for manufacturing the tendered items shall in conformity with IS and as per the technical specification and standard mentioned in the Section-VI.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Supplied materials shall be in conformity to IS Standards and as per the technical specification mentioned in Section-VI

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should declare that he is capable of supplying at least 25% of the tender Quantities per month as specified in the Section-V (Schedule of Requirement)
Bidder shall upload the self-declaration indicating that their firm is manufacturing or engaged in dealer of any other manufacturer (if so, indicate the Name and address of the original manufacturer)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The Bidder Must be a manufacturer or Dealer to any manufacturer
